title: Declare at least one SMOKE acceptance on every WMBT

facts.note: WMBT YAML files under the plan tree (resolvable via `atdd repo resolve <wmbt-urn>`). The rule is a standing invariant over every such file, regardless of whether it is being edited.
Fires when a WMBT is authored, edited, or merely inspected/reviewed/validated without edits; an existing noncompliant WMBT is in scope.
Validator test_wmbt_has_smoke_acceptance reports a WMBT with 0 SMOKE acceptance URNs.
Whether a WMBT genuinely has no real infrastructure to verify (the only exception) is a judgement, not a mechanical fact.

fires: A planner creates a new WMBT whose acceptances are all non-SMOKE harness types.
A planner edits a WMBT and removes or renames its only SMOKE acceptance.
A planner reviews or validates an existing, unedited WMBT that declares no SMOKE acceptance.
The validator reports a WMBT declaring 0 acceptance URNs with the SMOKE harness token.
doesNotFire: A WMBT already declares an acceptance with URN acc:<wagon>:<wmbt_id>-SMOKE-NNN[-<slug>] and identity.phase SMOKE.
A genuinely docs-only / metadata WMBT with no real infrastructure carries an unexpired suppression marker on its urn: line.
Plan artefacts that are not WMBTs (wagon manifests, docs).

given: Any WMBT in the plan — new, edited, or existing and untouched
when: the planner authors, edits, reviews or validates it
then: Ensure it declares at least one acceptance whose identity.urn matches acc:<wagon>:<wmbt_id>-SMOKE-NNN[-<slug>] and whose identity.phase is SMOKE.
prefer: Make the SMOKE acceptance the explicit real-infrastructure check between GREEN and REFACTOR.
Repair: `atdd repo resolve <wmbt-urn>`, open the WMBT YAML at the violation location, add the SMOKE acceptance, re-run the validator until clean.
avoid: WMBTs with no declared real-infrastructure (SMOKE) check.
Assuming downstream SMOKE tests suffice without declaring the acceptance in the WMBT.
Suppressing a WMBT that exercises real infrastructure, or without an UNTIL expiry.
unless: WMBT is genuinely docs-only / metadata with no real infra to verify: add `# atdd:suppress(planner.wmbt.must-have-smoke-acceptance) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD` on its urn: line, YYYY-MM-DD = today + 90 days.
why: Tester rules only check coverage of SMOKE tests that exist; without a declared SMOKE acceptance the lifecycle has no explicit real-infrastructure verification before REFACTOR.
evidence: Every WMBT YAML has at least one acceptance with identity.urn matching acc:<wagon>:<wmbt_id>-SMOKE-NNN[-<slug>] and identity.phase "SMOKE", or a valid suppression per unless[0]: the WMBT is genuinely docs-only/metadata with no real infrastructure to verify, and the marker `# atdd:suppress(planner.wmbt.must-have-smoke-acceptance) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD` sits on its urn: line with an unexpired UNTIL date set to today + 90 days when added.
verifier_detail: Count, per WMBT, acceptance URNs carrying the SMOKE harness token; a violation is a count of 0. Report location as the WMBT YAML path and line (e.g. plan/<wagon_dir>/<wmbt_id>.yaml:1). Applies to every WMBT file, edited or not.
Term smoke_acceptance: an acceptance URN carrying the SMOKE harness token; urn_shape acc:<wagon>:<wmbt_id>-SMOKE-NNN[-<slug>]; phase SMOKE.

Term suppression_marker: inline opt-out for genuinely docs-only WMBTs with no real infra; syntax `# atdd:suppress(planner.wmbt.must-have-smoke-acceptance) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD`; placement: the WMBT's urn: line, e.g. urn: "wmbt:<wagon>:<wmbt_id>"  # atdd:suppress(planner.wmbt.must-have-smoke-acceptance) UNTIL=YYYY-MM-DD. The source instructs substituting YYYY-MM-DD with today + 90 days.
Fix-hint resolve example from source: `atdd repo resolve wmbt:govern-lifecycle:E003` -> plan/govern_lifecycle/E003.yaml:1.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 3.50.0; aliases [].
Name: WMBT must have a SMOKE acceptance. Severity 3; disposition suppress-and-clean.

additions.justification: Required by the output schema; derived from the source statement ('Every WMBT'), fix hint and exception; adds no new obligation.
